title.zh: 轴对称 Picard 磁通 Green 更新

summary: Convert toroidal current density to cell currents, apply a dense cell-current-to-flux Green matrix, relax the resulting flux against the previous state, and report relative flux/current changes.

identity.relation: toroidal current-density grid and dense Green response to one relaxed axisymmetric flux update
identity.direction: R-Z grid, J_phi, previous/vacuum flux, Green matrix and relax -> psi_next, cell currents and relative changes
identity.definition: Form raw cell currents I=J_phi*dR*dZ using the first grid spacings; candidate flux is psi_vac+reshape(G_psi @ C_order(I)); return psi_next=relax*psi_state+(1-relax)*candidate. Compare psi_next against psi_state and the raw currents against the optional previous currents with the declared norm denominators.
identity.model: one axisymmetric dense-Green Picard step with flux relaxation, not current relaxation
identity.geometry: rectilinear cylindrical R-Z grid with at least three nodes per axis
identity.coordinates: [Z,R] arrays; Green rows and columns follow C-order field-point and cell-current flattening
identity.boundary: R starts at a nonnegative value; no external boundary solver or extrapolation is performed.
assumptions: g_psi maps one cell current in A to field-point flux in Wb in the declared order.
The first R and Z spacings are the cell-area convention even if later spacings differ.
relax is the weight of the previous flux, not a mixer for current values.

inputs.name: r_grid
inputs.constraints: Nonnegative, rectilinear and strictly increasing radial axis; at least three columns.

inputs.name: z_grid
inputs.constraints: Rectilinear and strictly increasing axial axis; at least three rows and same shape as r_grid.

inputs.name: j_phi
inputs.description: Caller-selected toroidal current density at each grid cell.
inputs.constraints: Same shape as the grid; this Operator does not apply a plasma mask.

inputs.name: psi_state
inputs.constraints: Same shape as the grid; used for flux relaxation and relative change.

inputs.name: psi_vac
inputs.constraints: Same shape as the grid and aligned with Green response rows.

inputs.name: g_psi
inputs.constraints: Finite square matrix with field-point rows and source-current columns in [Z,R] C order.

inputs.name: relax
inputs.constraints: Finite and 0 <= relax < 1; one is rejected.

inputs.name: previous_cell_currents
inputs.description: Previous raw cell-current array used only for the current-change diagnostic.
inputs.constraints: If omitted or null, compare against zeros; otherwise exactly match the grid shape.

outputs.name: plasma_cell_currents
outputs.description: Unrelaxed raw cell currents formed from J_phi and first-spacing area.
outputs.constraints: No relax factor is applied to this current array.

outputs.name: relative_psi_change
outputs.description: L2 norm of psi_next-psi_state divided by max(||psi_next||,||psi_vac||,tiny).
outputs.constraints: Uses the returned psi_next and the previous psi_state.

outputs.name: relative_current_change
outputs.description: L2 norm of raw currents minus prior currents divided by max(||raw currents||,1).
outputs.constraints: Previous currents affect this diagnostic only, not the flux update.

preconditions: The caller supplies a physically meaningful J_phi and a Green matrix in the stated cell-current/field-point convention.
All grid fields are same-shape finite arrays and g_psi has the exact dense square shape.
supported: One finite R-Z axisymmetric flux-feedback step with caller-selected current, external flux and flux-relaxation weight.
excluded: A complete converged equilibrium or automatic selection of iteration count.
Current relaxation or automatic active-cell masking.
Non-axisymmetric geometry, sparse-Green optimization, or a guarantee of finite arithmetic for all extreme finite inputs.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for wrong-rank, mismatched or nonfinite grid fields; negative/nonincreasing/nonrectilinear or too-small grids; invalid Green matrix; relax outside [0,1); or invalid previous currents.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Unexpected NumPy arithmetic failures propagate. Intermediate overflow in matrix multiplication or norm evaluation is not separately trapped by a finite-output guard.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable to one step; the caller controls and checks the iteration loop.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial mapping is returned after an exception.

provenance.lineage_summary: Maintained SciRel step mapped to a saved Pleiades L1 Picard update and direct tests; historical candidate labels are not current expert recognition.
source_kinds: saved L1 Operator contract and implementation

python.signature: update_axisymmetric_picard_flux(r_grid, z_grid, j_phi, psi_state, psi_vac, g_psi, relax, previous_cell_currents=None)

example.description: A diagonal unit Green response and constant current on a three-by-three grid reveal the cell area and flux-relaxation order.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.equilibrium import update_axisymmetric_picard_flux
r_grid, z_grid = np.meshgrid([0.0, 0.5, 1.0], [-0.5, 0.0, 0.5])
result = update_axisymmetric_picard_flux(r_grid, z_grid, np.ones((3,3)), np.zeros((3,3)), np.ones((3,3)), np.eye(9), 0.25)
np.testing.assert_allclose(result['plasma_cell_currents'], 0.25)
np.testing.assert_allclose(result['psi_next'], 0.9375)
assert result['relative_current_change'] == 0.75
example.expected: Raw cell currents are 0.25 A and the flux-relaxed next state is 0.9375 Wb at every grid point.

scope: Cell-area and flux-relaxation arithmetic on a small uniform grid.
Manufactured diagonal-Green update and both relative-change formulas.
Rejection of relax=1 and negative cylindrical radius.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Direct SciRel tests cover selected small-grid numerical and failure paths; they do not certify the physical Green response, convergence of a containing graph, or the first-spacing area convention on arbitrary nonuniform grids. No expert recognition is implied.
known_limitations: The function validates strictly increasing axes but does not require uniform spacing; current conversion still uses only the first spacing on each axis.
The previous-current input changes only the reported diagnostic.
Public distribution licensing and SciRel expert recognition remain pending.
